But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.

translations.web: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”
translations.bsb: so that the thoughts of many hearts will be revealed— and a sword will pierce your soul as well.”
translations.kjv: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.
translations.asv: yea and a sword shall pierce through thine own soul; that thoughts out of many hearts may be revealed.
